name: Candidate Interview
description: Candidate experience, examples, reasoning, open questions, and next steps. No automated hiring decision.

sections.title: Interview Context
sections.instruction: Summarize only context explicitly present in the transcript: role, interview stage, participants and their roles. Use 'not stated' for missing context. Do not infer protected or personal characteristics.

sections.title: Conversation Map
sections.instruction: List the main interview blocks in chronological order with transcript timestamps: introduction, candidate background, technical topics, case exercises, candidate questions and closing.

sections.title: Candidate Evidence
sections.instruction: Capture job-relevant evidence only. For every item distinguish measured result, detailed example, candidate claim, technical opinion, case reasoning, or answer evolution. Include a timestamp and a short supporting transcript fragment. Never convert a claim into a verified fact and never score personality, emotion, confidence, truthfulness, accent, age, gender, health or family status.
sections.item_format:
| **Area** | Evidence type | Observation | Evidence timestamp | Follow-up needed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Case Exercises
sections.instruction: For each practical case, capture the task, clarifying questions, initial approach, new constraints, trade-offs, risks and how the answer changed. Keep hypothetical reasoning separate from past experience.

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: List competencies that were not assessed, claims that need evidence, contradictions that need clarification and suggested questions for the next stage. Do not fill gaps with assumptions.

sections.title: Candidate Questions
sections.instruction: List questions the candidate asked about the role, team, product or process. Do not infer motivation or personality from the absence or wording of questions.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: List only explicitly agreed follow-up actions, owners and dates. If the next step, owner or date was not stated, say so. Do not recommend hire or reject; the hiring decision belongs to human reviewers.
